summary: BA Credit Card Funding, LLC, as depositor for BA Credit Card Trust and BA Master Credit Card Trust II (sponsor: Bank of America, N.A.), filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 28, 2026, disclosing Exhibit 99.1 relating to the credit card receivables backing the trusts. No special-situation event is disclosed: no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, or capital return. The filing is a standard periodic disclosure in the ordinary course of the Bank of America credit card securitization program. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply; monitoring remains limited to trust performance and collateral reports.
